evals.prompt: I just set up a new Node.js app running on port 3000 locally. I want to expose it through Cloudflare Tunnel so I can access it at app.mydomain.com. Can you help me set up the tunnel from scratch? I haven't used cloudflared before.
evals.expected_output: A complete guide with cloudflared tunnel creation, DNS routing to app.mydomain.com, ingress configuration pointing to localhost:3000, and instructions for running the tunnel (foreground test + service install)

evals.prompt: I already have a tunnel called 'main-tunnel' running with two services. I need to add a third service: Grafana running on http://localhost:3001, accessible at grafana.mydomain.com. Show me how to update the config and reload without downtime.
evals.expected_output: Instructions to update config.yml adding a new ingress rule for grafana.mydomain.com -> localhost:3001, and how to apply changes with minimal or zero downtime (restart service or tunnel)

evals.prompt: My cloudflared tunnel was working fine yesterday but today it's not connecting. When I try to access my app I get a 502 error. Help me debug this step by step - check the service status, logs, config, and local services.
evals.expected_output: A systematic debugging workflow: check cloudflared service status, check local services are running, inspect tunnel logs, validate config, test tunnel connectivity, and provide fixes for common issues
